summary: Completes the PDF-acquisition plan. Adds manual attach of a user PDF to an existing paper (POST /api/pdf/attach on top of the existing upload and take_imported_pdf; source_kind user_import; earlier files kept), a landing_page_only reason with an 'open the paper page' link for open-access papers that have no direct PDF link, and an 'attach a local PDF' action on every reader failure. Records live and browser evidence; sets E-PDF-ARCHIVE to passed (self-run) and PDF-01 to review.
scope_note: On top of 7937230. The untracked .claude/settings.json and .claude/worktrees/ are the owner's and not part of this unit.

budget_impact.rationale: No model call, no model operation or ceiling changed, and no new outbound request: attach uses the existing local upload; the landing page is opened by the user's browser.
budget_impact.before: Papers without a downloadable source showed a reason only; the reader could not attach a user PDF to an existing paper.
budget_impact.after: Every failure offers attaching a local PDF; open-access landing pages are linked.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; attach route and reader behaviour only

Two separate read-only code-review agents with fresh contexts (same model family as the author, not a human). Pass 1 found 8 issues in 1f5ada9..aba281e; pass 2 verified the fixes and found 5 residual items, which the author then fixed with tests; those last fixes were not re-read by a reviewer.

open_risks: The Tauri window itself was not exercised; the same static pages were checked in a browser preview.
Whether Unpaywall is needed rests on one non-arXiv sample (DreamerV3, landing page only).
Whether mailto still matters when an OpenAlex key is set is undetermined.
Reviewed by independent agents after this unit; the fixes are in 2026-10-04-review-fixes-and-mailto. A human review has not been done.
